faqs.a:
The presiding judge shall coordinate with the personnel department to establish and
               maintain such regular personnel records as may be necessary for each municipal judge
               appointed by the city council. The personnel records shall be retained and updated
               from time-to-time by the director of personnel or designee. Nothing herein shall be
               construed to establish any municipal judge as employee subject to the provisions of
chapter 70
.
(Code 1981, § 18-47; Ord. No. 3676, § 1, 1-22-2001)
